zh.caption: 圖 1｜三種識別的角色
zh.description: 三個平行查詢角度，並非先後流程或一對一對應；最後仍須核對公告條件與現場證據。

items.title: CVE｜漏洞個案
items.body: 用共同編號對照同一個公開漏洞；一個漏洞可能影響多個產品版本。

items.title: CWE｜缺陷類型
items.body: 同一類缺陷可出現在不同產品的許多漏洞；相同類型不代表相同事件。

items.title: CPE｜產品類別
items.body: 標準化產品與版本名稱；同名設備仍是不同資產，初步匹配需要再驗證。

en.caption: Figure 1 | Three identification roles
en.description: Three parallel perspectives, not a sequence or one-to-one mapping. Advisory conditions and local evidence still decide applicability.

items.title: CVE | Vulnerability case
items.body: Correlate the same disclosed vulnerability by ID; one vulnerability can affect several product versions.

items.title: CWE | Weakness type
items.body: One weakness type can recur across vulnerabilities in different products; the same type does not mean the same event.

items.title: CPE | Product class
items.body: Standardize product and version names; matching devices remain separate assets, and preliminary matches require further checks.
